claim.operational_target: Given a frozen structured content contract, produce up to three surface-form candidates while preserving every claim, reason, approved memory, uncertainty, protected entity, number, date, quote, negation, modality, causal direction, confidence, and structured field; select only a passing candidate and otherwise return the neutral rendering.
non_claims: prediction of what Steve Jobs would think or say
recovery of personality, beliefs, values, memories, or interaction decisions
free-form role play or identity simulation
validated human-level semantic equivalence or blind style recognition
alternatives: recognizable discourse markers alone explain any style score
short sentence length rather than person-specific style explains discrimination
a generic product-presentation register explains the observed surface pattern
human raters recognize topic leakage rather than style
claim.refusal_state: invalid_or_unfrozen_contract_or_profile_pollution; candidate-level failure falls back strong to standard to light to neutral
claim.scope: English surface rendering for public interview, keynote, and concise email modes using a locally audited Steve Jobs expression package; no direct user question access.

identifiability.distinguishing_evidence: Exact-segment preservation and closed-vocabulary wrappers distinguish surface-only rewriting from content mutation. Person-specific style recognition still requires a preregistered blind human or independent classifier evaluation against other real-person packages.
unidentified_questions: whether the selected surface markers are uniquely attributable to Steve Jobs
whether independent blind raters can identify the person after names and topics are removed
whether a future neural renderer preserves semantics beyond exact-segment templates

evidence.completeness_boundary: Local hashes and locators bind the supplied Nuwa files and approved surface rules. They do not prove the source corpus is complete, that research summaries are correct, or that style is person-unique.

computation.uncertainty_scope: The gate proves structural/exact-segment preservation under the bounded templates; it does not provide a learned semantic-entailment probability.

downstream_integration: tests/test_expression_renderer.py::frozen contract to neutral candidates gate and fallback

results.summary: 17 focused expression and HTTP tests passed
266 full regression tests passed in 205.683 seconds
neutral, three candidates, provenance, semantic checks, final selection, and pollution rejection observed; zero browser console warnings/errors

remaining_limitations: No preregistered blind human or independent classifier evaluation has established Steve Jobs-specific style recognition.
The semantic gate uses exact locked-segment preservation rather than a validated bidirectional NLI backend.
The profile is English-only and its source audit includes secondary Nuwa research summaries rather than a complete raw corpus.
This module does not assess or improve PCFM person-response prediction accuracy.
